card.name: Just before a capitalized proper name
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (on, a, the, comma, and) right before a capitalized proper name or title is expected, such as a bird species, a religious order, a day name or an office.

modes.label: Before bird or species names
modes.description: The word a, the or and sits right before a capitalized bird name.
modes.example: My favorite bird,<< a>> Brown Thrasher.

modes.label: In lists of names
modes.description: A comma or and inside a list of capitalized names, such as orders or days.
modes.example: Monday, Wednesday, Friday or Tuesday<<,>> Thursday, Saturday.

modes.label: Before a day or title
modes.description: A linking word before a capitalized day name or title.
modes.example: was a Leap year starting<< on>> Thursday

card.writes: It pushes the model toward capitalized proper-noun starts such as Web, Excel, Western and Sun.
card.plain: It fires on little words just before a capitalized name is about to appear.
